conclusions.statement: AVASAD is the cantonal organization and CMS Vaud is the public network identity used for the local centers.
conclusions.ambiguity: The compound legacy label AVASAD – CMS Vaud conflates two levels of the system.

conclusions.statement: AVASAD is an autonomous public-law association with legal personality.
The existing Lia record is a network-level umbrella identity, not one CMS operating unit or office.
The system has seven regional associations/foundations and approximately fifty local CMS units; the regional bodies are the employers through which CMS services are delivered.
conclusions.ambiguity: The official CMS site currently says 50 CMS while the Vaud public page says 49, likely reflecting different update dates.

conclusions.statement: The current AVASAD central/transversal contact is at Avenue de Rhodanie 60, 1014 Lausanne, not the legacy provider locality string Lausanne 1004.
conclusions.ambiguity: This central address is not a patient-facing local CMS identity.

unresolved: The authoritative current count is inconsistent between 49 and 50 CMS across official sources.
The exact provider-record granularity should be decided before selecting which local CMS units enter Lia.
No evidence reviewed supports mapping the legacy Lausanne 1004 location to a current AVASAD or CMS operating unit.

recommendation.oneRecordDisposition: Do not retain AVASAD – CMS Vaud as a single patient-facing provider. Preserve AVASAD as an organization identity and later create only explicitly resolved local CMS provider records linked through their regional organizations.
reasoning: The legacy record collapses cantonal governance, seven regional operators, and many local centers into one provider row.
Repurposing the umbrella row would misstate both contact identity and operating-unit scope.
